title: 番外假如朔衡变成反派2番外假如朔衡变成反派1
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
……
一间密室内。
朔衡擦去嘴角的鲜血。
那眉心的风雷印记上，已然多出一抹猩红的血印。
而站在他面前的逢生，眼底则闪过一丝满意之色：“嗯……很好。
禁制刻印的很成功。从此以后，只要你做出任何违背奉神命令的行为，你的灵魂就会——
砰。”
他说着，用五指比划出烟花炸开的模样。
“像这样，连同你的肉身一起，炸得连渣都不剩。”逢生直起上身，“当然，本尊相信你既然有如此觉悟，就不会做出背叛奉神的愚蠢行为。
当然，如果有人试图窥探你的记忆，那结果也是一样的。
关于这一点，你应该非常清楚才是。”
朔衡微微垂眸：“是。”
“很好。”
逢生非常满意自己的作品。
咚咚咚。
房门敲响，逢生抬眸扫去，不慌不忙的应了一声：“…进。”
从门外走来一位媚骨天成的女人。
她穿着一身薄如蝉翼的绸缎丝袍，对着逢生的方向恭敬下跪，露出胸前一片雪白的柔软。
“见过大人~”
逢生却没有理会她，而是转头看向一旁的朔衡。

那位紫衣青年已经起身。
除了眉心那抹若隐若现的红色，几乎和以往看不出区别。
“这是本尊答应过你的，那个对你母亲施咒的女人。”逢生脸上的笑意十分恶劣，目光从女人那张惊恐的脸上划过，又看向朔衡写满杀意的眼睛。
“现在，本尊给你一个亲手杀死她的机会。”逢生对女人的方向抬抬下巴，“放心，有本尊在这里。她不敢跑，也不敢还手。”
“大、大人……”
烬颜有些慌了。
不是，没人告诉她是来这里送死的啊！
她还以为逢生大人叫她前来，是因为她这次在下界的事情做得好。
虽然没能成功处理掉那群跟朔衡有关的人，但仅是晏情一人，也足够让那小子痛不欲生了。
却没想到，生前还有机会能看到这小子和逢生大人站在一起的画面。
朔衡根本没有丝毫犹豫。
对方是真我境？
那又怎样？
青枫剑在烬颜眼底化为一闪而过的青红流光。
她想躲开、想逃离，却被一股更为强大的力量死死钉在原地。
——是大人出手了！！！
这样的想法在脑海中略过，烬颜眼底不由得闪过一丝绝望。
怎么能……她明明也为奉神做了那么多……
content_en:
…
In a secret room.
Shuo Heng wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth.
There is already a scarlet blood mark on the wind and thunder mark between the eyebrows.
Feng Sheng, who was standing in front of him, had a look of satisfaction in his eyes: "Well... very good.
The ban engraving was very successful. From now on, as long as you do anything that disobeys God's command, your soul will -
Bang. "
He said, using his five fingers to make a picture of fireworks exploding.
"Like this, your body, together with it, will be blown up to nothing." Feng Sheng straightened up, "Of course, I believe that since you have such an awareness, you will not do the stupid act of betraying the gods.
Of course, if someone tries to peek into your memory, the result will be the same.
You should be very clear about this. "
Shuo Heng lowered his eyes slightly: "Yes."
"Very good."
Feng Sheng is very satisfied with his work.
Boom, boom, boom.
There was a knock on the door, Fengsheng raised his eyes and glanced over, and responded calmly: "...come in."
A charming woman walked out of the door.
Wearing a silk robe as thin as cicada wings, she knelt respectfully in the direction of Feng Sheng, revealing the soft whiteness of her chest.
"I've met the adults~"
Feng Sheng ignored her, but turned to look at Shuo Heng aside.
The young man in purple clothes had already stood up.
Except for the faint red color between the eyebrows, there is almost no difference from before.
"This is what I promised you, the woman who cast a spell on your mother." The smile on Feng Sheng's face was very evil, and his eyes passed from the woman's frightened face to Shuo Heng's eyes filled with murderous intent.
"Now, I will give you a chance to kill her with your own hands." Feng Sheng raised his chin in the direction of the woman, "Don't worry, I am here. She doesn't dare to run or fight back."
"S-Sir..."
Jin Yan was a little panicked.
No, no one told her that she came here to die!
She thought Master Feng Sheng asked her to come because she had done well in the lower realm this time.
Although they failed to deal with the group of people related to Shuo Heng, Yan Qing alone was enough to make the kid miserable.
But he didn't expect that he would have the opportunity to see this boy and Master Feng Sheng standing together before he was alive.
Shuo Heng didn't hesitate at all.
Is the other party in the true self state?
So what?
The green maple sword turned into a flash of green and red light in Jin Yan's eyes.
She wanted to hide and escape, but was pinned to the spot by a more powerful force.
——The adults took action! ! !
Such thoughts passed through his mind, and a trace of despair flashed in Jinyan's eyes.
How could it be possible... She has obviously done so much to serve God...
